reviews.title: The exceptional staff and assortment of amenities makes it a nice play to visit. It might be time to for a small facelif
reviews.text:
Great amenities! Exceptional staff! They always did their best to accommodate their guests. The grounds are very pretty. / We stayed in the casitas and the cleaning crew rarely came to pick up dirty dishes and glasses. We always had to ask for a fresh set of towels. 

The check-in process was unsatisfactory. After traveling all day, we were greeted by a woman that was quite firm about not letting us have our room until 4 pm sharp. We arrived at 2:50 and my husband had a broken leg with a cast up to his knee and needed to rest. So rather than making a suggestion as to a place to sit while we waited, she quickly dismissed us and our luggage. A member of the bar staff overheard the conversation and was quick to offer their lounge area and gave us a free round of drinks to at least make us feel comfortable for the next hour and ten minutes. First impressions are everything! 

The hours of food service at various onsite restaurants need to overlap their hours. It was hard to get a light meal or a snack late in the day after swimming, unless you opted for fine dining or room service. Not a big deal but a bit inconvenient.
reviews.author: Sanders

reviews.title: The Phoenician Scottsdale pas du tout à la hauteur d'un 5 étoiles
reviews.text:
•	Bel emplacement
•	Salle fitness correcte
•	Site et jardins agréables / •	Hôtel immense mais mal conçu : pour accéder à la salle fitness, il faut carrément traverser la route.
•	Chambre très éloignée de la réception et de la piscine, ascenseurs parfois en panne, salle de bain vieillotte.
•	Parking payant obligatoire avec des barrières défectueuses qui ne reconnaissaient pas la clé de l’hôtel durant tout le séjour.
•	Piscines peu entretenues, transats tachés et souillés de crottes d’oiseaux.
•	Accueil inexistant à la réception, personnel insuffisant et sans aucune attention particulière.
•	Restaurant steakhouse décevant : repas médiocre et, pour couronner le tout, un cheveu trouvé dans mon plat… signalé immédiatement mais sans changement d’assiette.


Conclusion :
Cet hôtel n’a rien d’un 5 étoiles luxe. Même un bon 4 étoiles serait généreux. C’est un établissement vieillissant, pas au goût du jour, avec des prestations très loin du standing annoncé. Je ne le recommande absolument pas à ceux qui recherchent un séjour haut de gamme. Il y a de bien meilleurs hôtels à Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Alexis

reviews.title: Great hotel with excellent location, food, and service.
reviews.text: The facility is beautiful and the entire staff was extremely helpful and friendly.  If you like to hike or walk, it’s very close to the Cholla trial and we walked into Old Town going through the neighborhoods (took about 50 minutes) but is great morning exercise.  If you are booking a room for a vacation, spend the extra money and get a reservation in the front building with a valley or pool view.  The view from your balcony makes for a great setting for morning coffee or afternoon cocktail especially from 3rd or 4th floor.  I think that the Valley view is nicer than the Mountain View unless you are in the back building— then take the Mountain view because the valley view has you first looking directly onto the hotel roof and front building.  The  food and service at the pool was excellent.  The golf course looked very nice.  I didn’t play but you can hit balls at the range with high quality rental clubs for $30 which was very reasonable.

reviews.title: it does look luxurious for the most part, but it doesn't feel luxurious
reviews.text:
We stayed at a Casita and we understand that it's in the dead of summer. here are the pros:
Air conditioning is great
kids play area is fun for kids
24-Hour pools
beautiful grounds
great Internet (kids didn't complain)
have cute things for couples or families to do multiple times everyday
Abel, a front desk bad ass, gave us the perfect welcome and was a very great dude overall / our room has cockroaches, spiders and crickets. I'm not mad at this. it's really hot outside and it's a very wet place. bugs are going to want to go inside. but the thing that grinds my gears here is that there was a big gap under the front door. they make it a big deal to remind you to keep the patio door closed because of pests but the real vulnerability is the front door. We did our best to fill in the Gap but the damage was already done. when we first arrived there was a big cockroach crawling on our pillows. when we called the front desk we didn't want to go through the trouble with switching rooms and just asked for some blood bug spray and sticky traps. The woman on the phone was very nice and wasn't annoyed that I called another time to ask for new pillowcases because I forgot on the first call. The pillowcases arrived pretty fast and the guy informed me that engineering would be coming over to help with some bug spray. they never came. we went and bought some ourselves and got traps.
pool amenities: it's really really hot outside during the day. we swam at sunset to avoid 111° death rays. The bummer part about this is that the kids water slide is closed before sunset. and you're no longer able to order anything and have it delivered to the pool. there are currently only eight people swimming. it's not like there's a rush of business. it would have been nice to get a couple smoothies at 8pm. I don't understand how you can order room service 24 hours but you can't get it delivered to the pool (which is closer to the kitchen). I would understand if it's a cleanliness thing, but there are wet towels, beer cans and empty plastic cups swimming across the entire upper floor pool.
nobody really apologized for the bugs or followed up with the request for spray or traps.
reviews.author: Melissa
